card.sentence: Push and open (or update) a PR for 1 branch, then merge each PR once its checks are green.

chain: Owner: the last apply was refused at the staged compile: the app feedback agent's exact tool allowlist refused advisor_ask and notify_owner, which every Codex agent gets by default. Make the compile give the feedback agent exactly its allowlist. Platform Engineer: fix it in the product repo and ship it. Done when merged into main with checks green.
claim:
PR title: fix(compile): the feedback agent drops the default advisor and notify tools

The live apply of #142 + instance #4 was refused at the staged compile (generation 11, nothing switched): the feedback agent's exact allowlist refused the advisor_ask/notify_owner tools every Codex agent gets by default. They're now stripped from the feedback agent, so it holds exactly its allowlist. A staged compile of the live instance passes the check.
